notes.title: v1.0.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[b] Full version is now live [/b]
Bugs fixed:
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug where the seed couldn't be picked up
    [*] The color blue should now be more blue...
    [*] Health drains more quickly after losing a body part
    [*] Options menu added to the main menu and first level
    [*] Mouse and keyboard controls now work even when there is a controller plugged in already
[/list]

[b] patch 1.0.3 [/b]
[list]
    [*] Quest appearing in menu shouldn't happen anymore
    [*] Fixed a few typo's
[*] Fixed platform cycles to better sync
[/list]
